notes.title: Update to item drops
notes.notes:
The item system isnt where id hoped it would be, and i cant stack items, or just make the vip passes rare, and steam support hasnt got back to me in nearly 3 months.

So i closed the ticked, removed drops by default (theres still an option to re enable it in settings)

But if you re enable it, its only going to drop 1 - 2 items a day after a buffer window now

So hopefully the item spam isnt as oppressive now.

If anyone has items they dont want, i dont think theres any way for me to delete them, but if you send me a trade request i think i can take them off your hands?

I dunno if theres limits to that

If there is, and it continues to be a problem ill try to find some other way to clean up the mess i caused.

I apologise again.

Im a little busy in the near future

But Ill hopefully be back to adding more pictures soon.

I might have a collab with denpafish lined up at some point for something special, but its not etched in stone right now

(Check their streams out here, theyre very fun and weird and chaotic) ːsteamhappyː
https://www.twitch.tv/denpafish

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44992455/bf1bebfc6527f3802062e7aff8d629a1a2f59a41.jpg

Hopefully the tracks can line up and the future of pixel paint can be a little brighter and less messy

Thanks for your time and patience, and sorry again ːlunar2019piginablanketː

notes.title: some changes
notes.notes:
save next puzzle as the one after the last one you beat so its more relative to what you selected

and added wasd controls for moving the camera

to make it hopefully a better experience for tablets and steamdeck

step left and right on color picks is now z and x instead of a and d

notes.title: Fixes and changes
notes.notes:
achievement trigger, clamp play area, items grey, resize window

Achievements should trigger on pack complete instead of the next completion now.

The visible play area is clamped to stop scrolling off into infinity by accident

Equipables are now grey when not collected to give better contrast for what you actually own

Should have got rid of the unity icon?  Im not sure yet tho ːlunar2019crylaughingpigː

And window should be resizeable now ːlunar2019piginablanketː

let me know however you feel comfortable if you have any suggestions or bugs youd like me to fix ːlunar2019piginablanketː
